description: Returns the paid x402 request for your order of Verified B2B contact list, 200 contacts (POST /buy/leads, $390 in one payment; schema linked); this call places and charges nothing, and an order exists only if your own client pays that request. POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client; the order id and status link come back with the receipt. Bad input is refused before any charge. Free check first: POST the same body plus your email to /buy/leads/check (email required there). 200 contacts, delivered within 3 days of payment (up to 2 more days if the list is short).

email.description: optional: where to send the files too; without it they are on the order status page
